'''Hanna City Harbor''' was the primary harbor for [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The harbor was home to a number of fishing ships and contained a large seafood market. Rebel agents often use the harbor to smuggle weapons and vital supplies for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], hiding them in crates of especially foul-smelling crustaceans to deter customs officers from inspecting them too closely.<ref name="Strongholds" />
